building_stock: The only door types the Maribyrnong records actually evidence are existing residential doors being retrofitted rather than new hardware on new doors — an Airtasker Maribyrnong VIC request supplies 'photo of lock plus 3 x photos of door and door frame' before booking, another asks to 'Install smart door lock on existing door', a Oneflare Maribyrnong VIC job asks the tradie to 'remove the existing lock and replace it with the smart lock, ensuring everything is securely fitted', and one completed Airtasker job was a deadbolt on a garage door; the same Airtasker review flags 'door work' as part of the job, meaning these doors need machining rather than a straight swap, so the practical requirement is measuring the existing door and frame first. Beyond that (unit vs house mix, door materials, era of stock) the returned records say nothing — insufficient local data, recommend manual research.
demographic_skew: The Maribyrnong demand visible in the records comes from self-directed, price-anchored buyers who source the hardware themselves and want install-only labour — one Maribyrnong VIC Airtasker post is 'Help me set up smart door lock (aqara u100) $400', a Oneflare Maribyrnong job states 'The lock is already purchased and ready to go' and 'Please bring your own tools' — and they schedule around work, with one Maribyrnong request 'Available anytime Friday, Sat or Sunday' and a deadline of 'Sunday 17th if possible'.
common_concerns: Whether the locksmith will install a smart lock the customer has already bought, rather than only selling their own — the Maribyrnong Airtasker post names a specific unit ('aqara u100') at a $400 budget and the Oneflare Maribyrnong job says 'The lock is already purchased and ready to go'.

Whether the smart lock will actually fit the existing door and frame — the Maribyrnong Airtasker lock-installation request attaches 'photo of lock plus 3 x photos of door and door frame' up front, and the Oneflare Maribyrnong job specifies 'ensuring everything is securely fitted and functioning properly'.
Mess and damage from the cutting and drilling the retrofit requires — the Maribyrnong Airtasker reviewer singles out that the installers 'left the house nice and clean post door work'.

Getting the job done inside a weekend or a set deadline — the Maribyrnong Airtasker request is 'Available anytime Friday, Sat or Sunday' and 'Needs to be completed by Sunday 17th if possible', and the Maribyrnong review praises 'quick availability'.
